blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The national president of transport group Piston, on Monday, denounced the reappointment of Vince Dizon as Department of Transportation (DOTr) secretary, saying the leadership reshuffle aims to push programs that will worsen the public transport system. In a statement, Mody Floranda said that there is nothing worth celebrating about Dizon’s leadership reassignment. “Walang dapat ipagdiwang sa pagbabalik ni Vince Dizon sa DOTr, na noong naupo ay nagtuloy at nagpatindi sa pagbebenta ng pampublikong serbisyo ng transportasyon sa mga negosyo, at nagwasak ng kabuhayan ng mga tsuper at operator,” Floranda said.
